coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Two of six ground-truth variable items fully match: standard versus fused Adam implementation, and gradient graph complexity measured through node counts, edge counts, and visualization clarity.
coverage.design_error_analysis: The output varies network architecture and unrolling iterations instead of holding them constant. It fixes some optimizer hyperparameters but does not preserve the complete training configuration. Omniglot and other standard meta-learning datasets are unspecified. TorchViz is used to render all conditions rather than treating TorchViz versus TorchOpt as the visualization-tool independent variable. Additional outcomes and numerical reduction predictions exceed the ground truth.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion_output is empty, so it does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: The required conclusion that operation fusion reduces gradient graph complexity and produces simpler visualizations is missing from conclusion_output, although a similar expectation appears within design_output.
